limits: All raw reports retained including canonical documents and every timing sample. Reports use bounded nested gzip to avoid repeated large archive inflation.
Portable replay rechecks recorded PCM hashes, not raw PCM samples; original runs hashed actual samples.
Optional originals/binaries/external-inputs/git-source checks require retained local evidence or Git history; binaries/compiler dependency payloads are not embedded.
Process snapshots show unrelated Node/esbuild/workerd and app/CUA workers; utilization was not sampled. Machine-wide idle is not proven.
Original CPU lockfile failure, preparation refusal and successful OFF/analyzer failure retained. Only still-unexecuted ON ran after mechanical serde-default correction. No timing retry/exclusion.

manual_gate.scope: Post-measurement selection-only gate; no Core/timing rerun
